mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review (record_id, round, review_date, is_done) VALUES (#{recordId}, #{round}, #{reviewDate}, #{isDone})
mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS reviewId, r.round AS round, r.review_date AS reviewDate, p.id AS problemId, p.leetcode_no AS leetcodeNo, p.title AS title, p.difficulty AS difficulty FROM review r JOIN record rec ON r.record_id = rec.id JOIN problem p ON rec.problem_id = p.id WHERE r.review_date <= #{today} AND r.is_done = 0 AND p.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.review_date ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE review SET is_done = 1, done_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{reviewId}
